order: Clean up the small residual items left over after the prior evidence-band gate returned its approve verdict, and add a ledger that tracks review rounds going forward. Scope is limited to the files the prior rounds already touch: the status file, roster/researcher.md, roster/wo9-band-record.md, and roster/wo9-n0-ex2-report.md — no new files, no changes to any role definition outside researcher.md's residual line. Keep edits small and targeted at the specific loose ends still open after approval, not a broader rewrite of the band record. Add the review-round ledger as a section inside the existing record file rather than a separate document, so the history of rounds stays in one place alongside the findings it tracks.
claims: Closed the residual items across the four listed files and added a review-round ledger section to the band record. Changes are small: 30 lines added, 19 removed across the status file, researcher.md, wo9-band-record.md, and wo9-n0-ex2-report.md. Verified by re-reading each touched file end to end to confirm the residual items referenced in the prior round are actually closed, not just noted.
